sources.title: GLM-4.6V official model card at pinned revision
sources.evidence: Exact GLM-4.6V card declares MIT licensing, the nominal 106B model, 128K training context and native multimodal function calling; it provides a runnable image-to-text example and a video-evaluation discussion.

sources.title: GLM-4.6V checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: Glm4vMoeForConditionalGeneration: 46 language layers, one initial dense layer, 128 routed experts with eight selected per token and one shared expert, 4096 language width, 96 query/eight KV heads, 24 vision blocks, untied embeddings, no next-token-prediction layers, and max_position_embeddings 131072.

sources.title: GLM-4.6V complete checkpoint index and all 41 indexed tensor headers
sources.evidence: Read only each indexed shard’s eight-byte header-length prefix and bounded JSON header at the same pinned revision, with HTTP 206/Content-Range checks. All 18,106 unique indexed tensors were present once: 18,061 BF16 learned tensors totaling 107,710,927,360 elements, and 45 F32 router correction buffers totaling 5,760 excluded elements. Every tensor shape and dtype matched the configured modules; byte spans were contiguous and matched dtype sizes. The metadata total_size value was not treated as a parameter count.

sources.title: GLM-4V-MoE implementation referenced by the developer
sources.evidence: Defines causal grouped-query attention, dense and sparse MoE MLPs, learned embeddings/output head, vision patch/position embeddings, 24 configured vision blocks, convolutional downsampling and MLP merger. Explicitly registers e_score_correction_bias as a buffer; rotary frequencies and position IDs are nonpersistent buffers. The expert packing preserves the three projection matrices’ coefficient count. The model has no image-generation decoder.

sources.title: GLM-4.5V and GLM-4.1V-Thinking technical report, revision 6 including GLM-4.6V
sources.publisher: GLM-V Team, Zhipu AI and Tsinghua University
sources.evidence: Introduction explicitly names GLM-4.6V as 106B-A12B and confirms thinking/non-thinking modes. Architecture section explicitly includes GLM-4.6V: AIMv2-Huge-initialized vision encoder, MLP adapter and GLM-4.5-Air language decoder. These are exact-model statements in the revised report, not a transfer from GLM-4.5V.

sources.title: Original GLM-4.6V release announcement in official README
sources.evidence: Project Updates explicitly announces the release of GLM-4.6V 106B-A12B and GLM-4.6V-Flash 9B on 2025/12/08. It states 128K training context and native function calling; the exact GLM-4.6V download row is labeled Hybrid Reasoning. The date comes from announcement text, not the commit timestamp.

sources.title: GLM-4.6V official API documentation
sources.evidence: Exact GLM-4.6V row documents video/image/text/file input, text output and 128K context. Native multimodal tool use, visual reasoning, document analysis and video understanding are described. Tool-returned or referenced images in generated reports do not establish native image synthesis.

name.note: Exact published name; distinct from GLM-4.6V-Flash and FP8 packaging.

developer.note: Official Z.ai model repository and API documentation.

family.note: Official card identifies the GLM-V series within GLM.

release_date.note: The original official README has an explicit dated release announcement.

open_weights.note: All 41 shards are publicly accessible in the exact official checkpoint.

license.note: The exact model card declares license: mit; the separate code repository license is not substituted.

parameters_b.note: Complete learned checkpoint count, not the rounded 106B author label: 106,852,245,504 language/output parameters plus 858,681,856 vision/adapter parameters. Includes separate 620,756,992-element input and output embeddings, all routed/shared experts, norms and biases. Excludes 5,760 router-buffer elements. No MTP tensors or quantization scales are present. All indexed tensor shapes were reconciled with module definitions.

active_parameters_b.note: Author-reported nominal 12B activated count for the exact GLM-4.6V 106B-A12B model. The sources do not give an exact convention covering embeddings, vision encoding, prefill and token decoding; this is not asserted to be a complete multimodal per-phase count. Configuration confirms top-eight routed experts plus a shared expert per MoE layer.

architecture.note: Vision encoder and MLP adapter feed a causal MoE language Transformer: one dense layer followed by 45 MoE layers, 128 routed experts/top-eight selection and one shared expert; grouped-query attention with 96 query and eight KV heads. The model is multimodal, not a text-only decoder.

context_window.note: Official card and API docs use 128K shorthand; the exact checkpoint max_position_embeddings resolves this to 131072, correcting the baseline 128000. This establishes checkpoint capacity, not a fresh live endpoint test.

modalities.note: API explicitly supports these inputs and text output. File/document support is a container for text and visual content. Interleaved image-text reports reference/crop/retrieve images through tools rather than establish native image synthesis.

reasoning.note: Exact-model report confirms thinking and non-thinking modes; official download table labels Hybrid Reasoning.

tool_call.note: Native multimodal function calling is explicitly documented for the exact GLM-4.6V release.

description.value: Vision-language MoE model with native function calling and optional reasoning
description.note: Describes verified architecture and capabilities without benchmark superlatives.

patch.description: Vision-language MoE model with native function calling and optional reasoning
patch.notes: The full BF16 checkpoint contains 107.71092736B learned parameters: 106.852245504B language/output and 0.858681856B vision/adapter. The developer labels the model 106B-A12B; 12B is a nominal active count whose exact multimodal phase convention is unspecified. The total includes untied input/output embeddings and excludes router correction buffers; there are no MTP layers. Context is 131072 tokens in the checkpoint, advertised as 128K.

summary: Verified all 14 fields. Added MIT, exact full 107.71092736B learned parameters, published nominal 12B active parameters and MoE architecture; corrected context from 128000 to 131072 and replaced the description. Original official release announcement confirms 2025-12-08. Full count independently reconciles all 41 shard headers and excludes non-parameter router buffers; no weights were downloaded. The published active count remains nominal because no exact multimodal phase convention is stated.
